review.rationale: Methodological contract for Test Card T007. The evidence decision lives in docs/standard. Cell counting and nutrient measurements are inherited from the published experiments.

question: Does layer-3 resource selection, from monoculture physiology alone, predict the dominance and coexistence regions of two-resource chemostat competition?

output.quantity: Si/P boundaries of the dominance regions and their log10 deviation from the observed boundaries
output.domain: Two diatom species in chemostats, Tilman 1977
output.accuracy: Observed boundaries are approximate (about 80 and 6) as stated in the source text.

model.assumptions: Monod growth on two essential resources (Liebig minimum); constant yields; well-mixed chemostat.
model.approximation: Ratio-only boundaries, valid when supply concentrations are well above R*.
model.parameters: No fitting; Table 1 values as published.

data_policy.holdout_policy: No holdout. Measured value seen before drafting (exposure SEEN_FULL), declared in Test Card T007.

system_partition.boundary: Two diatom populations and their shared nutrients in chemostats; the comparison uses published physiology and outcomes, not raw counts.

systems.state: Asterionella and Cyclotella cell populations and the shared phosphate and silicate pool

state_accounting.rule: Cells and dissolved nutrients in each chemostat.

systems.state: Microscope cell counts and nutrient assays

state_accounting.rule: Observer record only; carries no nutrient.

couplings.map: Sampling of the culture volume, handled upstream
Sample removal is part of the dilution flow; no further backaction admitted

observables.backaction_scope_reason: The populations are the only assessed owner.
observables.quantity: Dominance or coexistence at a given Si/P supply ratio

observation.source_state: Chemostat cultures as described by the source.
observation.generated_trace: Cell counts; not a UET trace variable.
observation.readout: Dominance regions and their Si/P boundaries.
observation.time_convention: Days of the published experiments; steady-state outcomes

components.reason: Monod growth on two essential resources with Table 1 physiology.
Applied upstream in the published experiments (cell counts, nutrient chemistry and flow control, Tilman 1977); not recomputed here.

error_budget.approximation: Ratio-only boundaries for supply well above R*; luxury consumption and flow-rate curvature of the boundaries not modelled.
error_budget.measurement: Observed boundaries are approximate statements in the source text.
error_budget.omissions: Luxury phosphate consumption by Asterionella; colony-size changes.
error_budget.dependence: Physiology measured separately from the competition runs.
error_budget.acceptance: Outcome categories fixed in Test Card T007 (|log10| <= 0.1 PASS, 0.1-0.3 INCONCLUSIVE, > 0.3 or no trade-off FAIL).

claim_boundary: Methodological coverage of the T007 comparison only. The evidence level is set in docs/standard. Layer 3 is the same model Tilman used, so the test is a re-analysis, not an independent experiment.
